description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining APIs for TR-069 device IP diagnostics trace route routehops. It includes function prototypes for retrieving trace route hop information such as host, host address, error code, and round trip times, and contains detailed documentation and macro definitions.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_Host
methods.description: Retrieves the host name or IP address for a specific route hop, indicating resolution success or failure.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_HostAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the last IP address or host name returned for a route hop, possibly from reverse DNS.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_ErrorCode
methods.description: Provides the ICMP error code associated with a route hop, if any.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_RTTimes
methods.description: Returns the list of round-trip times in milliseconds for each probe to a route hop.
